text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. For example, you can describe a picture, and an AI program will produce it in seconds. Some people worry that this will replace human artists, but others believe it helps them work faster and try new ideas. Human creativity comes from emotions, personal experiences, and imagination. Machines, however, follow patterns and data. They can copy a style but cannot truly feel or understand what they create. Perhaps the best results come when humans and AI work together.
